aborted_run.observed_error: litellm.InternalServerError: OpenAIException - Error code: 520 (Cloudflare origin error; payload retryable=True, retry_after=60)

recovery_trigger.peer_lane_action: Lane A was terminated immediately after lane B stopped to avoid new paid spend on the excluded r6 attempt; its in-flight seed1301 run was left without a terminal summary as an audit record.
recovery_trigger.root_cause_assessment: Provider 520 origin errors can persist for tens of seconds; the gateway-level retry loop uses millisecond backoff and the OpenAI SDK retry was disabled (call_kwargs.max_retries=0), so a 60-second-scale outage exhausted all attempts within milliseconds.
